rows.TEXT: In his youth, this mighty lord once stood fast against an army from hell and single-handedly defeated them by sealing the gateway that spew them. He then became sovereign of his realm.

Highest lord of the dwarf lords, he is known for his intensity in battle and his courage in the face of overwhelming odds. He once fought seven days and nights against the mighty red dragon ARFURUZON to finally defeat him.

Every child trembles at the hearing of this most infamous name. This lord of hell is known for her blood thirsts. It is said that she once ate 1000 slaves at a banquet given by Bethrezen for a victory against the kingdom of light.

Guard 
"Look! Angels approach! Count Crowley told us to expect you, Holy Ones. He has instructed me to tell you that we have a proposal for you. If you aid us, together we will be able to overthrow the corrupt Emry of Abrissel!"

Guard 
"If you will find for us the Holy Artifact and bring it back to us, we will help you enter the Elves' lands, through the mountains. Two pieces together form the key, and we have but one. Surely in your infinite power you can accomplish this task."

Guard 
"I feel ashamed asking spiritual beings to do mortal work, but we are unable to recover it ourselves. We believe that the artifact is being held in an Elven treasury  north of here."

Demon Lord 
"Angels...err...yes, of course. My most...blessed...servants! For your good faith, we shall recover this artifact for you. Wait for us here...and pray...for the Highfather shall surely answer your every prayer."

Advisor 
"Hah! Bethrezen's power reaches us still! These fools see us as their beloved angels. The minds of the weak are so easily manipulated, and Crowley must be the weakest of all. How sad that their own religious passion should lead to their demise!"

Advisor 
"Master, the artifact we found is that which Crowley's guards requested. We must return it to them for the key immediately!"

Imp 
"Then we can feast on their flesh!"

Guard 
"Good. You have found the item! We have waited so long for this. We are gaining ground! Here is the key, Holy Lords:"

Guard 
"With this key you may open the secret passage through the mountains, where you will find Lachla'an, the Elven Avatar. To find the secret passage, go westward to the tower in the water. Have the key with you."

Guard 
"You will find Lachla'an hidden in a library across the mountains west of the Empire Capital. The Empire believes that it is a secret, but we have eyes and ears everywhere. The Elves will think they have been betrayed!"

Guard 
"You will find Lachla'an hidden in a library across the mountains west of the Empire Capital. The Empire believes that it is a secret, but we have eyes and ears everywhere. The Elves will think they have been betrayed!"

Ogres 
"You killed our leader! Revenge will be ours, and suffering yours!"

Orc Champion 
"You think you win? It is you who lose, when Elves done with you. Ahahaha!"

Advisor 
"What are these stupid Orcs blathering about?!"

Advisor 
"These Dwarves know more than they let on - they have battle plans with detailed information on how they plan to attack the Elves."

Advisor 
"It seems that the Elves are now fully integrated with the Empire. We should expect to fight both races united. Oh, the bliss it will be to see the bodies of both Man and Elf strewn about the battlefield!"

Baroness 
"This piece of land is worthless! We cannot simply content ourselves with this! Massacring these peasants is the only thing worth our time here."

Advisor 
"The lands ahead have a strange glow to them. What is it, Scout?"

Scout 
"Master, we have seen the lands ahead. There are Dragons, and they seem to be under the control of the Elves. We think they are being used as protection! Could the Avatar be controlling them?"

Advisor 
"Speak Elves! Tell us where to find your 'Avatar', and your death just might come all the sooner!"

Elves 
"Your threats are wasted. Lachla'an has the power of Gallean within him - something you'll never be able to touch."

Advisor 
"You will soon regret your tongue, Elf! Guards, remove it, and then throw that filth into the dungeon!"

Advisor 
"Out with it, Elves! Where is he? We will slaughter you one by one until you tell us!"

Elves 
"For us, Gallean's silence would be death."

Advisor 
"Perhaps we'll keep you alive then and feed you to the dogs, piece by dripping piece!"

Elf Lord 
"We know that you are coming to stop our alliance. But these attacks will be of no consequence when the ritual is complete. Where one of us falls, two Empire soldiers will take our place!"

Advisor 
"The Dwarven scrolls we found spoke the truth. The Empire and Elves together will rain death upon us with their collective air magic. We must find a way to shield ourselves against it. The light chills our burning flesh!"

Duke 
"I cannot help but admire Crowley's tactics. He overtaxes the peasants and if they refuse to comply, he has them guillotined in the town square. Ruling by fear is an admirable goal."

Counselor 
"All the gold he collects is sent to his capital to build all types of opulent shrines. Perhaps we should ally with this Crowley, for the moment; he certainly has all the right priorities.

Duke 
"He's a fool who believes he does work in the name of the Highfather when he really does our work for us. This will make him easy prey for us. When we're done using him we'll have a banquet, with him as the guest...err...dish of honor!"

Advisor 
"We've noticed that Crowley's Armies consist mostly of inquisitors and religious fanatics while Emry's army seems to be knights and wizards...the Empire's division is eating it from inside!"

Duke 
"And of course we'll do everything we can to speed up the process, won't we? Hah! It is in the nature of humans to be easily blinded by faith - see how foolishly they worship the despicable Highfather!"

Advisor 
"The Greenskins here are from the Northlands. They were expecting many more troops very soon. We should be cautious."

Advisor 
"We've found evidence of training being held here. No wonder the local Greenskins were so fierce. And with all that muscle, their meat is so tough."

Advisor 
"The Clans have been preparing some sort of ritual here. It will be very powerful! This is not simple magic. Why would they be performing this now? It may be to launch an offensive against us!"
All hurts can be mended here.

Advisor 
"We have not found anything here. These Humans are loyal neither to the Empire nor to Crowley. They erected that statue to represent their freedom. As I said, not much of interest."
I am feeling very generous today

Advisor 
"Master, it seems as if Crowley is so self-absorbed that he cares little for his peasants. Their living conditions are horrid and they subsist on the poorest of rations. I suppose he will not even notice if we take these cities."

Duke 
"I knew there was a bestial odor about this place...werewolves. They must have been hiding from Crowley's Inquisition."
Goods from around the world is all I have for sale!

Scout 
"Master, I do not see any indications of the Avatar and his Library any further north. We've gone too far. Let us turn south."
You can go to war with my goods... But not without!

Advisor 
"Master, I believe that the tower ahead may help us. It specializes in air magic, certainly we should be able to convince the wizard inside to teach us a ward."
My items are the best in the realm.

Duke 
"Master, the time has come for us to break up the glue that binds the Elves to the Empire: their Avatar, Lachla'an. This temporary alliance keeps the Empire in the Elven sacred lands until the Elf arrives."

Duke 
"We need the sacred lands! The longer we remain in this realm, the weaker we become! We need our connection to Bethrezen and that magic well is the only way to keep it. Enough time has been wasted already."

Arch-Devil 
"It is true. Our father needs us just as we need him. What power can one Elf have anyway? We hear he is a healer, an oracle, and an educator...hardly noteworthy qualities."

Lachla'an 
"It...cannot be! I still see visions of the future...I am not slain today."

Advisor 
"Oh, you most certainly are. Gulmuskae, Esremerios, Kremnimus, tear him apart and scatter his remains! We don't want the Elves trying to bring him back from the grave. We'll make sure his visions are false!"
I will train your units for a price.

War Advisor 
"Master, the Greenskins are still protecting the Elves in this area. They have established bases east and west of here. We should be wary of surprise attacks!"

Advisor 
"This appears to be a simple artifact. However, it may serve us later. We should keep it."
My soldiers are the finest in the region.

Spy 
"By the Highfather, then it's true! I am unworthy of this honor, seek Crowley's Guards to the East."

Duke 
"What is this? How dare they assume we would collaborate with them! That fool should have been slain where he stood!"

Spy 
"Holy Lords, you are near. Lachla'an resides south of here in a tree-dwelling. Your actions will have great consequences! One more thing - Count Crowley sends his unending thanks for your intervention. He wishes to meet again, when you finish here."

Advisor 
"Those wolves...I have never seen anything like them. They are certainly not of the mortal world. Perhaps they are shapeshifters or illusions? What strange magicks the Dwarves are attempting I cannot say, but something is not right."

Scout 
"Master I can't say that I understand what we see here. I swear this used to be a portal into the Elven lands."

Duke 
"You useless lout! How can we get to the Elves now?"

Counselor 
"Master, this may be the answer to why Crowley wants us to meet him. It is obvious that he too wants the Elves destroyed, and now neither of us can achieve it."

Demon Lord 
"Why don't we see what we can get out of those miserable humans- we can always massacre them later. That deranged spy said to meet their guards  in the east."

Counselor 
"The fools! It worked! No one can stop the massacre now! Soon all humans will be under Bethrezen's rule."

Advisor 
"There it is...Lachla'an's retreat. Crowley's servants led us right to him. Let's get this over with!"

Lachla'an 
"Ah, so you've come for me. I will not die this day. I have foreseen my own death...though it is fogged... but I do not sense it will be now. I will yet walk these lands after this day."

Advisor 
"Can it be true? Can this Elf see into the future? No, he is but a weak, delusional preacher. We must slay him! Now!"
